faqs: Where is AzuriteCon?
AzuriteCon will be held at the Inner West Pride Centre, 1 Bedford St, Newtown NSW 2042.
When does online ticket sales end?
Online Eventbrite sales end Thursday, 15 April 2027. Tickets will then be available to purchase at the door on the day.
Can I buy tickets on the day?
Yes, you can buy Market Entry tickets on the day only. The Panels & Performances ticket is online sales only, and once ticket limits are reached will no longer be available to be purchased online.
How do I apply for Artist Alley?
Use the Artist Alley application link on this website. We suggest applying as soon as possible, as we will close applications once a suitable number has been received.
How accessible is the venue?

The venue has a lift which can be used to access the market. All artist tables, mirror and clothing racks will be located in the hall, and the free activity tables are on the stage which has stairs but no ramp. Please see Azurite-Con staff for a free activity pack if you cannot access the stage.
Do you provide free tickets for companions or kids?

We do not offer free tickets for companions, all companions must purchase a ticket to enter the venue. Kids 12 and under are also required to purchase a ticket on the day. Those who are aged 13+ are required to purchase a Market Entry ticket.
What do I do if I purchased the wrong ticket?

If you purchased a Market Entry only ticket, you can use the ticket for either day without needing to change it. However if you purchased a Panels & Performances ticket and miss the event we are unable to offer you a refund. Tickets are non-refundable.
Can I leave the event and come back later?
Yes you can! Each attendee will be provided with a wristband, which you will need to show our staff for re-entry. There is a different wristband for each day.
How do I get to the venue?
The venue is at 1 Bedford St in Newtown, close to Newtown Train Station and King Street. Please refer to our social media closer to the date about how to get to the venue from Newtown Station.
Where can I find bump-in details?
Artist bump-in times, loading instructions, parking and pack-down information will be published on this website for accepted artists, which will updated closer to the date of the event.
